newsitem.title: USA: Vidamed sees Q4 revenues above $2.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Vidamed sees Q4 revenues above $2.4 mln.

text.p: VidaMed Inc said it expects to report fourth quarter revenues exceeding $2.4 million compared with $210,000 in the year-earlier period.
It cited sales of its TransUrethral Needle Ablation (TUNA) System in the U.S. for the higher revenues.
The Menlo Park, Calif.-based company did not give earnings estimates. Officials were not immediately available to comment.
The company started selling the system after it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance in October 1996. The system is a minimally invasive treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia.
